questions.question: Rohit donates 15% of his monthly income to charity funds. The remaining income is spent in the following manner: 35% on food, 20% on rent, 17% on bills, 8% on clothing, and the remaining is kept as savings. If the amount saved each month is ₹14,620, then what is Rohit's monthly income?
questions.solution:
Let us consider Rohit income as 100%

Rohit donates 15% of his monthly income to charity funds → 100% - 15% = 85%

The remaining income of Rohit = 85%

Let us consider this 85% of total income = X/-

In remaining income, Rohit spent 35% on food, 20% on rent, 17% on bills, 8% on clothing = 35 + 20 + 17 + 8 = 80%

Expenses of Rohit = 80% of X

Savings of Rohit = 20% of X

The amount saved each month is ₹14,620 by Rohit → 20% × X = 14620

⇒ (20/100) × X = 14620

⇒ (1/5) × X = 14620

⇒ X = 73100/-

∴ As, we considered 85% of total income = X/-

Here, 85% of total income = 73100/-

⇒ 100% of total income = 100 × (73100/85)

⇒ 100% of total income = 100 × 860

∴ Total monthly income of Rohit = 86000/-

Hence, the correct answer is **"₹86,000".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All fruits are stems.

Some fruits are leaves.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some stems are leaves.

II. Some leaves are fruits.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5dc925168d7d55542280535c8d303ed764469c44a20468e6601d78d8fb65576.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some stems are leaves → True (As All fruits are stems and Some fruits are leaves so, Some stems are leaves is True)

II. Some leaves are fruits → True (As All fruits are stems and Some fruits are leaves so, Some leaves are fruits is True)

∴ Here, Conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘MAGNET’ is written as ‘HFTIJO’. How will ‘CULPRIT’ be written in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd42e50b6fe489fe11ffa2f4537d72ce15bf14b7393924b474a0ac17ef7246ac.png] 

**1) Vowels are increased by + 5.**

**2) Position value of the consonant 3) Position value of the consonant > 10, Code will be - 5**

 

‘MAGNET’ is written as ‘HFTIJO’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2463b3db439a885513a69bb7dd1a8be3eb406dac64aab54334f5be07b3bf2cd0.png] 

Similarly,

‘CULPRIT’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac88b24458e7c6b3489ee26500a9ffa6e02cd46114eaf28078ac9a766032d296.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"XZGKMNO".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Vowels are increased by + 5. For Eg: A is coded as F which is +5 position from A. Similarly U is coded as Z which is +5 position from U.
 
• Position value of the consonant less than 10, Code will be the opposite letter . For Eg: G is coded as T which is the letter opposite to G in the alphabetical order. Similarly C is coded as X which is opposite to C in the alphabetical order.
 
• Position value of the consonant greater than 10, Code will be - 5 position from the letter. For Eg: M is coded as H, which is -5 positions away from M. Similarly P is coded as K, which is -5 position from P.

questions.solution:

questions.question:
In an imaginary mathematical system, symbol '–' stands for addition, symbol '+' stands for division, symbol '×' stands for subtraction, and symbol '÷' stands for multiplication. What is the value of the following expression?

144 × 35 + 7 ÷ 12 – 3
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2b6f3febac246330db69a1f2d7e1d64be3e45a19926fdfbc26f1f404ff8e655.png]

The given equation : 144 × 35 + 7 ÷ 12 – 3

After changing the symbols in the given equation the equation is as follows : 

= 144 - **__35 ÷ 7__** × 12 + 3

= 144 - __**5 × 12**__ + 3

​= __**144**__ - 60 **__+ 3__**

​= **__147 - 60__**

**​= 87**

Hence, the correct answer is **"87".**
